recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Add title text 'Precision and Recall of Multi-class classification' at top center, bold sans-serif, red (#C00000), approx 28-32pt.
3. Add slide number '18' in a yellow circle at top-right corner.
4. Draw a green-bordered rectangle on the top-left for the confusion matrix. Inside, add header 'Predicted as' with subtitle '(Positive Class)'.
5. Create table with columns: Dog, Cat, Fish, Total. Rows: Dog, Cat, Fish. Add vertical 'Actual' label on left.
6. Fill cells: Row Dog: 5, 2, 1, 8. Row Cat: 4, 6, 1, 11. Row Fish: 7, 0, 0, 7?. Highlight cells with yellow fill (#FFF2CC).
7. Add blue text 'Confusion Matrix' to the right of the table.
8. Create three equal columns at the bottom. Each column has: pink header box with class name (DOG Class / CAT Class / FISH Class), yellow box with Precision formula, orange box with Recall formula.
9. Fill in exact formulas: Precision=5/(5+4+7)=5/16; Recall=5/(5+2+1)=5/8; Precision=6/(6+2+0)=6/8; Recall=6/(6+4+1)=6/11; Precision=0/(0+1+1)=0; Recall=0/(0+0+7)=0.
10. Use sans-serif font throughout; body text black (#000000).
